set.body:
PRD V-8, TY-5, A-15. Current tests and external consumer suites are extensive, but no complete public-symbol-to-executed-test inventory or entry-point coverage gate exists. This is an audit plus enforcement task, not a claim inferred from test count or package coverage percentage.

1. Freeze candidate SHA and generate a reviewable public API inventory per module/platform (compiler/Scaladoc-derived where feasible): types, public constructors/smart constructors, methods/overloads, extension methods, instances and published laws. Explicitly classify synthetic/generated, inherited, deprecated and JVM-only entries; exclusions have a reason, never silently disappear. State how newly public symbols are detected.
2. Map every retained entry to named executable tests/public consumer examples and evidence of successful invocation; mere textual name matches and compilation do not prove execution. Every abstraction also names a real instance and a law/conformance suite. Exercise failure branches that define each smart-constructor contract, not only happy-path construction.
3. Probe from an external package through public APIs (private constructors, malformed values, mutable-array aliasing and nominal frame/clock disagreement); use typeCheckErrors for compile-time rejection claims. Compare JVM/JS inventories, with JVM-only IO exceptions explicit. Keep numerical independent-oracle quality separate from entry-point coverage.
4. Produce a finite uncovered-entry report with exact owners and close the actual gaps. Add a CI drift check, demonstrate failure on an added unmapped public symbol and on a removed/misnamed test mapping, and retain meaningful execution evidence rather than allowing arbitrary strings to count as tests. Where execution cannot be mechanically attributed, name and review that limitation instead of claiming a percentage proves it.

Acceptance: no unexplained unexercised public entry or uninhabited/untested abstraction at the candidate; CI detects inventory/evidence drift. Start the inventory now and rerun it after method work. doc-mdoc owns public documentation examples, doc-scaladoc owns API prose; this ticket is not a blocker that prevents implementing the missing methods. Review: docs/TRACKER_REVIEW_2026-09-19.md.
set.title: Audit: every public entry point exercised
